product.name: Sunsama Daily Planner
product.description: A digital daily planner that organizes work tasks, meetings, and emails into a unified daily schedule to help users plan and manage their day.

product.name: Sunsama Integrations
product.description: Connects Sunsama with external tools like project management apps, email services, calendars, and communication platforms to synchronize tasks and schedules.

product.name: Sunsama Desktop and Mobile Apps
product.description: Applications for desktop and mobile devices that provide access to Sunsama’s daily planning and scheduling features.

product.name: Sunsama Ambassador Program
product.description: A referral program that rewards users and influencers for recommending Sunsama to others.
